mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.`name`, p.permission FROM sys_tenant_permission as tp LEFT JOIN sys_permission as p on p.id = tp.permission_id WHERE tp.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
select p.*, tp.`id` as tenant_permission_id from sys_permission as p inner join sys_tenant_permission as tp on tp.permission_id = p.id and p.deleted = 0 order by p.sort_no
